reasoning: The request is a silent, locked-camera observation of rain on a night bus window, pinned to exactly three shots. No reference assets, dialogue, lettering, music, or replacements are supplied, so those fields stay empty and prohibited. Balanced creativity only shapes framing, pacing, and ambience; it adds no score or text. The three shots are staged as a wide opening, a closer insert, and an extreme-close finale, each with the camera locked and a distinct visible change in the water on the glass.

shots.action: A locked camera holds on a bus window at night, the glass beaded and streaked with rain. Beyond it, city lights sit far out of focus as soft amber and white smears, and the dim interior of the bus is barely legible in the lower corner of the frame. Droplets track downward in slow, uneven lines, and the wet pane catches faint moving reflections from outside.
subjects: out-of-focus city lights beyond the glass
sync_sound: a low, muffled bus engine hum
shots.what_changes: The scene is established and the first runnels begin to lengthen down the pane.

shots.action: The locked camera now holds closer on the same rain-covered glass. One larger droplet trembles, meets a smaller bead beside it, and the two merge into a single heavier drop that slides downward, clearing a narrow, wavering path through the condensation. Behind the glass, the blurred lights shift only slightly, keeping the focus on the water itself.
sync_sound: a soft wet tick as droplets merge
faint rain ticking on the glass
shots.what_changes: Two droplets merge into one and begin to slide, opening a thin clear trail through the condensation.

shots.action: The locked camera settles into an extreme close-up on the wet pane. The clear trail left by the sliding drop widens and distorts the city lights behind it into long, trembling streaks. More fine beads gather at the top edge and start to creep downward, while the glass holds its dim, cool reflections and the night beyond remains unfocused.
subjects: extreme close view of wet glass
distorted city lights beyond the window
sync_sound: a faint watery trickle down the pane
shots.what_changes: The cleared trail widens and further distorts the lights beyond, while fresh beads gather and begin to descend.
